label: CAT-2: KB/RAG v4.0 (KBv6 Vector Retrieval)
description: Comprehensive CAT-2 test suite for KB retrieval via KBv6 (3 namespaces: Sessions/JTBD, iMessage, Assessment). 25 scenarios covering essay feedback, coaching history, conversation context, and hybrid SQL+RAG queries.
